claim_ceiling: These cases test evaluator logic only. They do not qualify a physical machine, worker, partner, facility, or production process.

evaluation_contract.fail_closed_rule: A candidate is Eligible only when every hard requirement is explicitly resolved and satisfied at the scheduled operation time.
evaluation_contract.known_absence: Missing required record in a Complete snapshot is Blocked.
evaluation_contract.unresolved_absence: Missing required record in a Partial or Unknown snapshot is Indeterminate.
evaluation_contract.conflict_rule: Known hard violations produce Blocked even when other facts are unresolved.
evaluation_contract.duplicate_reference_rule: Multiple records matching one required stable reference are Blocked; input order must never select one.
evaluation_contract.skill_rule: Eligibility requires available_qualified_people to be known and >= minimum_people for every required skill; known shortfall is Blocked, unresolved headcount is Indeterminate.
evaluation_contract.configuration_rule: The exact process configuration must be valid at scheduled_at, match the required parameter SHA-256 digest, and carry current configuration qualification evidence.

cases.name: Qualified matched operation
cases.reason: All required revisions, assets, skills, lots, utilities, clearances, and inspection evidence are current and matching.

cases.name: Candidate profile
cases.reason: A candidate profile is not a production-eligible qualification.

cases.name: Unknown machine state
cases.reason: Unknown asset state cannot be interpreted as available.

cases.name: Expired calibration
cases.reason: The scheduled operation occurs outside the calibration evidence validity.

cases.name: Wrong pattern revision
cases.reason: A configuration qualified against another pattern revision cannot be reused.

cases.name: Quarantined input lot
cases.reason: A quarantined lot cannot enter an accepted production route.

cases.name: Unknown utility availability
cases.reason: Unknown utility service state is not available capacity.

cases.name: Required skill absent from complete snapshot
cases.reason: The complete workforce snapshot proves that the required skill is not covered.

cases.name: Required skill unresolved in partial snapshot
cases.reason: Incomplete workforce evidence cannot prove either presence or absence.

cases.name: Wrong facility context
cases.reason: A cell qualification is site-specific and cannot be silently reused at another facility.

cases.name: Unknown evidence validity window
cases.reason: Evidence without a resolvable validity interval cannot establish current qualification.

cases.name: Duplicate process-configuration identity
cases.reason: Ambiguous canonical identity must not be resolved by input order.

cases.name: Missing inspection-plan evidence
cases.reason: A plan identifier without current supporting evidence is not enough for eligibility.

cases.name: Utility unit mismatch
cases.reason: A numerical comparison across incompatible units is invalid.

cases.name: Insufficient known utility capacity
cases.reason: Known insufficient service capacity blocks the operation.

cases.name: Revoked qualification evidence
cases.reason: Revoked evidence cannot continue authorizing a planned operation.

cases.name: Missing independent profile verification
cases.reason: A qualified profile cannot rely solely on self-asserted qualification evidence.

cases.name: Process capability mismatch
cases.reason: A process configuration must bind the exact process capability requested by the operation.

cases.name: Process configuration expired before operation
cases.reason: Process qualification evidence does not extend the configuration's own validity interval.

cases.name: Process configuration digest mismatch
cases.reason: A changed process parameter set cannot reuse evidence bound to a different digest.

cases.name: Insufficient qualified operator headcount
cases.reason: A skill label is not enough when the available qualified headcount is below the declared minimum.

cases.name: Unresolved qualified operator headcount
cases.reason: Unknown operator availability cannot be interpreted as adequate staffing.

cases.name: Malformed process parameter digest
cases.reason: A malformed parameter digest cannot bind a process configuration to immutable evidence.

cases.name: Zero minimum operator requirement
cases.reason: A zero-person skill requirement is invalid and cannot bypass staffing constraints.

cases.name: Forged eligible claim with unknown asset
cases.reason: Independent verification must recompute the asset state rather than trust the evaluator's previous result.

cases.name: Forged eligible claim with tampered evidence set
cases.reason: The independent verifier must reconstruct the evidence set from the snapshot and reject an incomplete claim.

publication_requirements: Publish all raw cases and per-case reason codes.
Record exact source commit, evaluator version, input digest, and operation evaluation time.
Run at least 30 repeated randomized input-order permutations for determinism checks.
Use an independent verifier implementation before claiming optimizer-to-verifier agreement.
Do not publish synthetic fixture results as measured factory capability.

independent_verifier_contract.rule: Only a positive Eligible claim can be Verified. Verification independently recomputes the hard predicates and evidence-reference set from the immutable owner-resolved snapshot; it does not call the evaluator.
